contexts.text: Seven ears ascending on one stalk () = the scientifics of the Natural which are conjoined. Ears, or ears = the scientifics of the Natural. Explained. AC 5213.
The scientifics which are here signified by ears, or ears, are the scientifics of the Church.

The seven kine = those things which are of the interior Natural, and which are called the truths of the Natural; and the seven ears = the truths of the exterior Natural, which are called scientifics. AC 5263:end.
Seven thin ears () = scientifics of no use. AC 5215:2.
The seven thin ears swallowed up the seven fat and full ears () = that the scientifics of no use exterminated the good scientifics. Explained.

The seven good ears are seven years () = the states of the multiplication of truth in the exterior Natural. Ears, in a good sense, = scientifics; and therefore the truths of the exterior Natural; for these are called scientifics.

The seven empty ears, blasted with the east wind () = the states of the multiplication of the falsity which infests the exterior Natural. Ears... in the opposite sense, = the falsities of the exterior Natural.
